workflow_goal: Play the requested song in Spotify and verify playback starts.

inputs.name: song_name
inputs.description: The song title or search query to play in Spotify.

steps.title: Resolve And Play Track
steps.goal: Resolve the best matching Spotify track for song_name by searching the Spotify web catalog via the browser harness and extracting the track id, then start playback by opening the spotify:track:<id> URL scheme (which uses the user's existing logged-in Spotify session). If multiple plausible matches are returned, use constrained LLM judgment to choose the best match from structured track metadata. Verify Spotify is playing the resolved track.
steps.success_criteria: Spotify is running, playback is active, and the current track title/artist metadata matches the requested song query.
